run_video_read: run the SimpleVideo script to read a .pango video file frame by frame using --pango
run_video_seek: run the SimpleVideo script with --startFrame to seek to a specific frame index
run_video_stream: run the SimpleVideo script with --pangoOut to stream frames to an output .pango file
review_VideoInput: review the pango.VideoInput class used to open and read video URIs in SimpleVideo
review_VideoOutput: review the pango.VideoOutput class used to write video streams to an output URI
